note: All entries are drafts until checked against the sources listed. Bin rules vary by council during Simpler Recycling rollout.

bins.name: General waste (black or grey bin)
bins.accepts: Items that cannot be recycled or composted

bins.name: Dry recycling
bins.accepts: Clean paper, card, plastic, metal and glass as set by your council

bins.name: Food waste caddy
bins.accepts: Food and certain food-soiled items as set by your council

items.name: Paper coffee cup
items.reason: The plastic lining makes it hard to recycle in most areas.

items.name: Greasy pizza box
items.reason: Grease and food contamination stop it being recycled; the clean lid can usually go in dry recycling.

items.name: Plastic yoghurt pot
items.reason: Rinse first. Check your council, as some plastic types are not accepted.

items.name: Glass jar
items.reason: Rinse and remove the lid. Glass is usually accepted in dry recycling.

items.name: Batteries
items.reason: Do not put batteries in household bins. Take them to a collection point or shop with a battery bin.
